p: Brian Robinson is on IR after a practice setback and will miss time.
The RB2 role behind Bijan Robinson is vacant and Robinson is not a fantasy option for now.
Brian Robinson will not play Sunday.
His absence removes a backup RB option and may slightly raise Bijan Robinson's workload.
Brian Robinson will keep a role in the running back rotation alongside Bijan.
He was praised alongside Bijan, so he looks like a real part of the rushing attack. Exact split of touches wasn't discussed.
I thought Bijan and Brian were both outstanding.
